cardOverview.overviewText: A top-tier version of Xcite that maximizes lifestyle and travel rewards, offering higher cashback, milestone bonuses, and additional perks for premium users.

benefitRows.name: Concierge
benefitRows.offer: Enjoy concierge services including customized travel, entertainment, or leisure experiences, booking flights/hotels, and arranging golf sessions.
benefitRows.howToAvail: You may dial 1800 210 0298 (toll-free) or 022-42320298 for concierge assistance.

benefitRows.name: Dining
benefitRows.offer: Enjoy upto 30% discount on over 300+ eligible restaurants.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the AU Small Finance Bank Silver Spoon Dining Program using your registered account. Browse the available dining and order-in offers, select your favorite meals or restaurants, and apply the benefit at checkout to enjoy elite privileges at top restaurants. Complete the payment using your AU Xcite Ultra credit card to unlock the offer.
